parameters.name: HwCapabilities
parameters.description: {{list}} Wireline Wireless Convergence hardware capabilities supported by the CPE. {{enum}}

parameters.name: SwCapabilities
parameters.description: {{list}} Wireline Wireless Convergence software capabilities supported by the CPE. {{enum}}

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Sets the mode the CPE is operating in. Whilst the CPE is expected to auto-negotiate, a service provider may need to lock the CPE in {{enum|FN-RG}} or {{enum|5G-RG}} mode for stability. {{enum}}

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The mode the CPE is operating in. A CPE in {{enum|Negotiating}} is deemed to be auto-negotiating its operational mode. {{enum}}

object.description: Base object for Wireline Wireless Convergence. The controller can use this object to learn the supported 5G features and whether the 5G-RG is operating in 5G mode.
